audit_scope: Classification content, entity matching, date alignment, geography, fixed effects and influence; all existing primary results preserved.
date_precision: Almost every supplied interview date is the first day of the month. Delay figures are approximate, and month-midpoint sensitivities are retained.
text_inspection_limit: Assistant reading of a fixed stratified sample; not independent human accuracy validation. Negation candidates include genuine ghosting accounts. Removing all candidates is a deliberately conservative bound.
company_matching: Auxiliary CIK disagreements affect 5335 of 310920 main-sample reviews. Largest examples have corroborated issuer names/GVKEYs and SEC financial CIKs; an auxiliary-ID mismatch is not automatically a wrong company link. Excluding conflicts and matching root-employer posting/review scope did not establish attenuation. Current-root scope is not dated historical ownership.

influence.interpretation: Fixed full-control model; no recalculation of clipping or ranks; coefficients only, not significance-selected deletion. All firms retained in primary.

signal_accounting.interpretation: Exact Frisch-Waugh-Lovell covariance accounting, conditional on the full model nuisance terms. Contributions are descriptive algebra, not causal effects or separately estimated component slopes.
